observation.value: Final design acceptance for the review-UI capability: the user ran the full AC-001 gate loop on the signed build (record across two apps with live streaming rows under the Stop banner, stop, draft review, save, reopen, edit title/description/classification, step delete, reveal in Finder, hard delete through the confirmation). The one reported design issue (Reveal/chevron overlap) was fixed in d62c51f3 and visually verified on the signed rebuild (row-hover screenshot: Reveal fully visible beside the chevron with clear spacing). The user then explicitly directed: no further review pass needed, make the fix and merge — recorded as the human confirmation of the final design gate. The two capture-domain observations were routed to the capture capability (issue #38 and ADR-0001 semantics) and do not bear on the review-UI direction.
